items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Even Johnny Smith couldn't do that.

ctx.x: So were you reading chords then?

... No, the first time I ever thought about it must have been about '68 or '69. ... I say, "damn, everybody always ask me can I read this, can I read that. So I got no teacher, so I got a little old book. So I set myself up there with that book and count and one and two and three. See, the funny part it is one is all right but "and" is a pretty mean broad. ... But I get that, and I got a few more cues, and then I had to learn my fingerboard pretty good. ... As far as the reading thing, I finally got so I could…
Did jam sessions have much to do with the development of Bebop.
